_note: Macro theme -> IDX stocks map. direction: up = theme is on when the driver rises, down = when it falls. Edit stocks freely (IDX codes without .JK).

themes.name: Gold rally
themes.why: Higher gold prices lift revenue and margins of gold miners and gold-jewellery retailers almost one-for-one.

themes.name: Copper / base-metals rally
themes.why: Copper is the best free proxy for base metals and global growth; it drives copper-gold miners and moves with nickel and tin sentiment.

themes.name: Oil rally
themes.why: Upstream oil & gas producers and oilfield services earn more when crude rises.

themes.name: Oil falling
themes.why: Cheaper oil cuts fuel and logistics costs, eases inflation and fuel-subsidy pressure on the rupiah - good for consumers, retail and transport.

themes.name: Palm oil rally
themes.why: Vegetable-oil prices move together; higher prices lift plantation earnings.

themes.name: China / Hong Kong rebound
themes.why: China is the main buyer of Indonesian coal and nickel; a China rebound lifts demand expectations for commodity exporters.

themes.name: Rupiah strengthening
themes.why: A stronger rupiah brings foreign inflows into big banks and helps importers and consumer names with dollar costs.

themes.name: Rupiah weakening
themes.why: Exporters with dollar revenue and rupiah costs (pulp & paper, coal, plantations) gain when the rupiah weakens.

themes.name: US yields falling
themes.why: Lower global yields make Indonesian banks, property and dividend payers more attractive and raise rate-cut hopes.

themes.name: Risk-off shelter
themes.why: When fear rises, money hides in defensive staples, healthcare and telco - they usually fall less.
